verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bitwarden's own pieces of this story: organization vaults with collections, members and groups managed through the Public API, plus a built-in TOTP generator. A paying team also reports that its killer feature is safer account sharing that includes 2FA. However, no first-party doc describes sharing TOTP-bearing logins into collections or setting per-member permissions on them, so the access-control part is only implied. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of collection sharing with per-member or per-group permission levels, and explicit confirmation that TOTP seeds and codes are shared with collection members.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control

citations.quote: The Bitwarden Public API provides organizations a suite of tools for managing members, collections, groups, event logs, and policies.
